title: Content of a lernapps explainer, format 2
description: Format 2 of an explainer's content, as YAML in src/: src/app.yaml, src/<chapter>/chapter.yaml, src/<chapter>/<page>.yaml and src/data/<name>.yaml. It is format 1 (explainer.v1.schema.json) plus the app's place on the learning map: format: 2 and either strand or subject in src/app.yaml, and on each page the competencies it practises, or recap on a page that repeats a competency from elsewhere. An app.yaml without format is format 1.

strand.description: The one strand (Strang) of the learning map the app belongs to, <subject>/<strand>, e.g. mathematik/stochastik; or none if it belongs to none (then it is not on the map).

subject.description: The subject (Fach) of the learning map of a unit app: an app that practises competencies of several strands of that subject, e.g. franzoesisch. Only a subject whose learning map allows it (explainerFocus: competency) may have such an app; the catalog and lernapps check check that, as this schema does not know the map.

competency.description: A competency of the learning map, <subject>/<competency>, e.g. physik/gewichtskraft-berechnen.

app.description: src/app.yaml in format 2: format: 2 and either strand (an app of one strand, or of none) or subject (a unit app across the strands of a subject), never both; everything else as in format 1.

format.description: Always 2. Without it, the content is format 1 (explainer.v1.schema.json).

page.description: src/<chapter>/<page>.yaml in format 2: a page as in format 1, plus competencies, or recap on a recap page.

competencies.description: The competencies (Bausteine) the page practises, ids of the app's subject (the subject of its strand, or its subject); as a rule one. In a unit app (subject), all competencies of a page belong to one strand. Required when the app has a strand or a subject; leave it out with strand: none and on a recap page. The catalog checks the ids when it lists the app.

recap.description: Makes the page a recap page: it repeats a competency that the app's competencies require but the app does not practise, e.g. physik/gewichtskraft-berechnen. Use it instead of competencies, also with strand: none. A recap page has descriptive blocks only, no exercise; the link to the competency on the learning map is added for you.
